review.policy: Default 5 GiB trigger, 8 GiB recovery target, 3-day preservation; actual free space checked after deletion. Global policy merges all cameras oldest-first.
review.effects: Four image families only; candidate path constrained to media root and root device. Thumbnail path checked before deleteAsset. Pending generation or referenced upload rechecked under exclusive media lock.
review.error_boundary: Video worker catches effect errors, rolls back and marks unfinished task FAILED. This review does not claim filesystem/database deletion is one atomic transaction.

limits: New cases deterministically publish work after enumeration, not simultaneous multi-process publication. Existing separate-session lock tests cover producer/deleter ordering.
No physical disk failure, abrupt power cut, external upload or 24-hour test performed.
Historical I/O latency uncertainty remains open.
No new native Settings/UI coverage is claimed.
